title: The Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion
summary: We prove the Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion: for every free ultrafilter on ℕ, a nonzero unital separable complex C ∗ -algebra absorbs the Jiang–Su algebra if and only if its norm central-sequence algebra has no characters. We also prove that the infinite minimal tensor power of every nonzero unital separable complex C ∗ -algebra without characters is $`\mathcal Z`$-stable and contains a unital copy of $`\mathcal Z`$.
family_title: The Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion and infinite tensor-power Jiang–Su stability

review.reason: Proves a character criterion for absorbing the Jiang–Su algebra in separable C*-algebras.
